scope: Twelve Data one/five-minute US-stock provider adapter
behavior: Selected USD instruments on XNAS, XNYS and ARCX support one- and five-minute bars
The API key is caller-supplied and sent in an Authorization header, never in the request URI
Symbol, MIC, USD currency, interval and timezone-requested UTC timestamps are verified
Exact decimal OHLC, range invariants, integral volume, unique timestamps and future-time rejection fail closed
HTTP and provider-payload authorization, missing-data and rate-limit failures remain distinct
Identical concurrent lookups share one credential read and network request
The adapter registers independently in the same provider-neutral intraday registry

hostChecks.format: dart format applied to lib and test

Display or redistribution rights for a published App were not obtained
